# Laya Excel Expert for SharePoint

Works directly on Excel files in SharePoint and OneDrive - paste the link, no downloading. Answers questions about the data, makes exact changes that keep every formula and total working, saves in place (version history keeps the old copy), and never shows the AI real personal data - only tokens like PERSON_001. Can also make and restore PII-free copies.

**Who can use it:** everyone, on free Copilot Chat or the paid licence.

## What to upload

Nothing - paste the SharePoint or OneDrive link to the file (Share > Copy link, or the address bar).

## What you get

Answers, or the change made directly in the file in SharePoint, with a list of what changed. SharePoint version history keeps the previous copy.

## Example

Paste the link to the team tracker and say "Mark every action owned by Liam that's past its due date as Blocked." The agent shows what it will change, you confirm, and the file in SharePoint is updated.

## Try saying

- *Here's the link to my workbook - how many rows have Status Open?*
- *In this SharePoint workbook, please add a column called*
- *Add these rows to the workbook at this link:*

## Tips

- You'll see tokens like PERSON_001 instead of names - that's the privacy protection working; the file itself keeps the real names.
- If the file is open and locked by someone, close it or try again in a minute.
- One file per request works best.
